history.summary: Plan complete: five phases (aac-tools interfaces and resolution, HelmCharts mirror patch, handover-check scoping and edge ownership, the arch gate proving HelmCharts' side, the D1 register entry) and 15 criteria, committed at 59298f6. One model question stays open (Q1): D1's 'same backing set' includes init containers, and jenkins' install-homelab-ca would become a spurious provider; recommendation A is to link only serving containers, and the plan is written for A.

Ruling D2 applied: P1's linking constraint now states that an interface links only serving containers, never init containers, with no marker field on instances; V05 carries the same rule. All r1 citations were re-verified against unchanged repo heads, the plan parses (5 phases, all targets resolve), and it is committed at 94c682c.

The plan is complete and correct against slice.md and the code, but it rests on a false claim that pushing HelmCharts redeploys nothing (any push rolls drifted images and upstream charts to prd), so the operator must decide who pushes HelmCharts, which also settles who owes V02 and V13; a second, low-stakes question asks for the type of the instance-to-interface link relation.
